sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The prior instruction remains valid: the unknown branch still only requires a Table 6-9 lookup case and separately constrains the ship-owned propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard quantity, without binding that quantity to the lookup-selected result, so an arbitrary speed can pass. Locate or supply the canonical result/value path or relationship, declare it in the dependency contract, and constrain the unknown branch so the Table 6-9-selected result supplies the ship-owned quantity in REV-PER-MIN.
